visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white strapless corset-style top and a denim mini skirt with pockets, walks directly toward the camera. Her hands swing naturally at her sides, and she maintains a neutral but pleasant facial expression. The setting is a luxury hotel corridor featuring warm, golden-toned lighting and reflective, vertical wall panels that create a repetitive, rhythmic background pattern. (2) The visual frame momentarily freezes into a stylized photographic overlay, capturing the woman in a posing stance with her head tilted slightly. She is still wearing the white top and denim skirt. The background lighting remains consistent, highlighting the texture of the fabric and the smooth surface of the corridor walls. (3) The woman is now walking in a new outfit consisting of a black long-sleeved crop top with a wide neckline and a black pleated mini skirt worn over dark sheer tights. Her face is directed forward, and she performs a subtle shoulder movement. The corridor perspective narrows behind her, maintaining the same warm indoor lighting. (4) In this phase, the woman appears in a deep maroon or burgundy long-sleeved bodysuit featuring a hip cutout, paired with dark-wash denim jeans and black heels. She walks with a confident stride, her hands moving slightly as she looks toward the lens. The reflective wall elements continue to dominate the background scenery. (5) The woman transitions into a more casual look, wearing a black bolero-style top over a grey sports bra and light-colored high-waisted shorts with white socks. She walks toward the camera before coming to a stop, clasping her hands together in front of her waist while smiling warmly.
